method: op.gg champions tab, queue_type=SOLORANKED (Solo/Duo only). current = Season 2026; previous = Season 2025 (op.gg param season_id=31). Tables list champions with >=2 games. weighted_pool score = sum over seasons of season_weight (current 1.0, previous 0.5, older 0.25 - none fetched) x games x (0.5 if games<5 in that season). Pool lists champions with >=3 total games, top 15. Flex is not included in the pool (only Þór's flex table is stored, under flex_current). competitive_picks_2026 = champions from Kia deildin 2026 Leaguepedia scoreboards (from the task brief).

GubbiFitness.notes: Very high volume (851 solo games this season). Twisted Fate is the signature pick (154 g, 56%; also 4x mid TF in Spring comp, played TF top in Autumn). Real top pool: Wukong, K'Sante, Garen, Fiora (Fiora 151 g last season = old main), Ambessa (33% WR in soloq - weak), Yasuo/Yone, Singed, Rumble (38% WR). Mid pool: Ahri, Viktor, Syndra, Anivia, Orianna, Kassadin (69%). Comfort high-WR: Kassadin 69%, Sion 64%, Zaahen 60%, Wukong 56%. SoloQ-only (never seen in comp): Viktor, Anivia, Kassadin, Nasus, Yasuo, Zaahen, Pantheon. Comp-only-ish: Gnar (7 g, 43%). Last season he also played Smolder (76 g) and Sivir bot.

Dréson.notes: Carry/assassin jungler: Rengar (107 g, 49%), Kha'Zix (62 g, 58%), Nocturne (48 g, 63% - best comfort pick), Lee Sin, Naafiri, Talon jungle.
